The year '''1044 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Events==
*The [[Beju-Tallah dynasty]] begins ruling on [[Gala]].<ref name="Beju-Tallah date">According to ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]'', the [[Beju-Tallah dynasty]] had ruled [[Gala]] for a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as of the events of the novel. Since ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''The Mark of the Crown'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the Beju-Tallah dynasty began ruling in 1044 BBY.</ref>

==Births==
*The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tan Tengo]] is born.<ref name="TanTengoBirthYear">Page 53 of the novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] mentions that Tan Tengo is a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] from reaching the age of thirteen. As the [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], this places Tengo's birth date in 1044 BBY.</ref>
